question: In a certain code language, FRAGRANCE is written as ESZHQBMDD. How will EXCELLENCE be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/998afc9c812597936918aabf24e2022719728b5c11e749642ee23d5753573129.png] 

Given: FRAGRANCE is written as ESZHQBMDD.

Logic: Alternate subtraction and addition of 1 in the positional value of the alphabets as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f49475b2e17d1588c55f40f4653c4eaa8e2845d28a68e052e4b49d0827f56a54.png] 

Similarly, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8f518b3f325cecf76d3696acfe0dff853a8d5fd76c646a09547462c2ae46046.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "DYBFKMDOBF".**
